name: extractDocument
description: Read one document with Amazon Textract. Call it first WITHOUT docType to get the text; after classifyDocument, call it again WITH docType to extract the key fields.

docId.description: Document ID from getDocuments, e.g. DOC-1A2B3C4D

docType.description: Optional. One of claim_form, repair_invoice, hospital_invoice, medical_report, id_document

name: classifyDocument
description: Classify a document whose text was already extracted, as claim_form, repair_invoice, hospital_invoice, medical_report, photo_evidence, id_document or other.

name: validateFields
description: After every document is extracted and classified: cross-check the fields against the case and policy, list missing documents and flag low confidence. Moves the case to DOCUMENTS_PROCESSED.
